description: We are seeking a talented Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in building and maintaining data pipelines, working with large-scale datasets, and implementing cloud-based data solutions.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines
Develop ETL processes to integrate data from multiple sources
Optimize data storage and retrieval systems
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to support their data needs
Implement data quality checks and monitoring
Work with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Participate in code reviews and maintain documentation
required_qualifications: 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related field
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience with data pipeline tools (Apache Airflow, Luigi, etc.)
Experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, etc.)
Experience with data warehousing solutions (Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake)
Strong understanding of data modeling and database design
preferred_qualifications: Experience with real-time data processing (Kafka, Kinesis)
Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
